QuestInfo.name: Age of Chaos-Aran
QuestInfo.1: Lilin insists that it is Aran's duty to help the Explorers and Cygnus Knights. Though they have strength and enthusiasm to join in the ancient battle, they don't know enough about the Black Mage. Go to the Warrior Elder #bDances with Balrog#k in Victoria Island and tell him you are interested in joining the Maple Alliance.
QuestInfo.2: Lilin insisted that it's Aran's duty to help the Explorers and Cygnus Knights. You told Warrior Elder #bDances with Balrog#k at Victoria Island that you wanted to join the Maple Alliance.\nDances with Balrog was overjoyed to welcome a hero like you to the Alliance.

0.0: You feel it too, don't you, #b#h0##k? The Black Mage's power...it's growing. We need to end this ages-old war, and quickly. The Explorers and the Cygnus Knights have joined forces to fight him, but their strength isn't enough.
0.1: They simply don't know what they're up against. You know better than anyone how evil the Black Mage is. Will you help them?

yes.0: You should find #bDances with Balrog#k, the Warrior chief in Victoria Island, and offer to join the Maple Alliance. We have to join forces if we're going to win.

no.0: Hey, you're supposed to be one of the Heroes! Act like it!

1.0: Ah, you must be Aran, the warrior woken from ice...we finally meet. What brings you to Perion?\r\n#L0##bI wish to join the Maple Alliance.#l\n#k
1.1: You do? Ah, I had prayed this day would come... You will be of immense help to the Alliance. Everyone will be overjoyed to hear this news.

yes.0: But first, you must work hard to regain your full strength. You aren't what you used to be... It will be a great effort. I will contact you when the time to fight together comes.

npc.0: You should find #bDances with Balrog#k, the Warrior chief in Victoria Island, and offer to join the Maple Alliance. We have to join forces if we're going to win.
